# TPT Pay

> TPT Pay is an open-source payments API (a Stripe-style alternative). It takes payments with
> payment intents, refunds them, and sends signed webhooks. This is pre-release software: see the
> status table in the repository README before relying on any capability.

## Authentication

Send a secret key (sk_test_... or sk_live_...) as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Publishable keys
(pk_...) may only retrieve and confirm payment intents. Test keys act only on test-mode data.

## Core endpoints

- POST /v1/payment_intents: create a payment intent. Body: amount (integer, minor units), currency,
  capture_method (automatic | manual), metadata. Secret key only.
- GET /v1/payment_intents: list payment intents, newest first. Query: limit (1-100), starting_after,
  status. Secret key only.
- GET /v1/payment_intents/{id}: retrieve one payment intent.
- POST /v1/payment_intents/{id}/confirm: attach a payment method and authorize. Body: payment_method.
- POST /v1/payment_intents/{id}/capture: capture an authorized amount. Secret key only.
- POST /v1/payment_intents/{id}/cancel: cancel. Secret key only.
- POST /v1/refunds: refund a payment. Body: payment_intent, amount, reason. Secret key only.
- GET /v1/refunds: list refunds, newest first. Query: limit (1-100), starting_after, status
  (pending | succeeded | failed), payment_intent. Secret key only.
- GET /v1/refunds/{id}: retrieve a refund.
- POST /v1/webhook_endpoints, GET/DELETE /v1/webhook_endpoints/{id}: manage webhook endpoints.
- GET /v1/webhook_deliveries: list recent webhook deliveries with status and attempts.
- POST /v1/webhook_deliveries/{id}/replay: send a delivery again (same event ID).
- POST /v1/api_keys, DELETE /v1/api_keys/{id}: create and revoke API keys.
- GET /openapi.json: the OpenAPI 3 document for all of the above.
- GET /health, GET /readyz, GET /metrics: operations.

Errors are JSON: { "error": { "type", "code", "message", "param" } }. Invalid parameters are 400.
Write requests accept an Idempotency-Key header; reusing a key with a different request is 400.
Rate limits return 429 with Retry-After.

## Webhooks

Event types sent today: payment_intent.created, payment_intent.succeeded,
payment_intent.payment_failed (a declined authorization), payment_intent.canceled, charge.refunded.

Each delivery carries a TPT-Signature header (t=<unix time>,v1=<HMAC-SHA256 hex of "t.body">).
Verify the raw request body before parsing it. Receivers should de-duplicate on TPT-Event-Id.

## Test payment methods (sandbox)

pm_card_visa approves. pm_card_declined, pm_card_insufficient_funds, pm_card_expired,
pm_card_cvc_incorrect decline with the matching code. pm_card_network_error returns an unknown
outcome. pm_card_slow approves after two seconds. Each pm_card_* token also works as pm_test_*
(for example pm_test_declined).

## SDKs

- JavaScript / TypeScript: npm package @tpt/pay (packages/tpt-pay)
- Python: pip package tpt-payments (packages/python)
- Command line: `tpt` (packages/tpt-pay-core/cmd/tpt): login, keys create, trigger, logs, replay

## Not available yet

Subscriptions, invoices, customers, disputes, payouts, and a hosted checkout page are planned and
are not served.
